input_references.role: One-row-per-driver summary of completed trips and waiting-time behavior

metadata.goal: Analyze the demand and service-time structure of taxi operations over one day, including how waiting and passenger-trip durations vary across drivers.
metadata.role: Urban taxi demand and service analyst
metadata.dataset_description: The main table contains completed taxi request events with request, pickup, dropoff, waiting-time, passenger-trip-duration, driver, and service-channel fields. The secondary table contains one row per driver for the observed day and summarizes completed trips and waiting-time behavior.
metadata.header: Taxi Demand and Driver-Level Service Time Across One Day

insight_list.insight: Taxi demand is highest from 08:00 to 16:00 and reaches its lowest level during the early-morning hours.

plot.title: Taxi Demand by Hour
plot.description: The hourly number of completed taxi requests is plotted across the observed day.

insight_list.question: How does the number of taxi requests change over the course of the day?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare the hourly demand profile before examining service-time differences.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv('trip_events.csv')
d['request_time'] = pd.to_datetime(d['request_time'])
d['hour'] = d['request_time'].dt.hour
counts = d.groupby('hour').size()
counts.reindex(range(24), fill_value=0).plot(kind='line', marker='o')
plt.title('Taxi demand by hour'); plt.xlabel('Hour'); plt.ylabel('Completed requests'); plt.show()

insight_list.insight: Average passenger waiting time is much longer than average passenger-trip duration, while most completed passenger trips last no more than 15 minutes.

plot.title: Waiting Time and Passenger-Trip Duration
plot.description: The two service-time distributions are compared, with the 15-minute trip threshold shown.

insight_list.question: How do passenger waiting times compare with passenger-trip durations, and how common are trips lasting 15 minutes or less?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare the two service-time distributions and the share of short passenger trips.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv('trip_events.csv')
summary = pd.DataFrame({'Waiting time': d['wait_time_minutes'], 'Passenger-trip duration': d['passenger_trip_duration_minutes']})
summary.plot(kind='box')
plt.axhline(15, color='red', linestyle='--', label='15-minute threshold')
plt.title('Waiting time versus passenger-trip duration'); plt.ylabel('Minutes'); plt.legend(); plt.show()

insight_list.insight: Driver-level waiting times are strongly polarized: some drivers have short average waits, while another group has substantially longer waits, producing a two-peaked distribution despite the long overall average.

plot.title: Average Waiting Time by Driver
plot.description: Each driver's average waiting time is shown to reveal the separation between short-wait and long-wait groups.

insight_list.question: How does average waiting time vary across drivers, and does the driver-level distribution show distinct groups?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Use the driver-day summary rather than only the overall trip average to compare service capacity.
insight_list.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv('driver_day_summary.csv').sort_values('mean_wait_time_minutes')
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))
plt.bar(d['driver_id'], d['mean_wait_time_minutes'])
plt.xticks(rotation=60); plt.ylabel('Mean waiting time (minutes)'); plt.xlabel('Driver')
plt.title('Average waiting time by driver'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

insights: Taxi demand is highest from 08:00 to 16:00 and reaches its lowest level during the early-morning hours.
Average passenger waiting time is much longer than average passenger-trip duration, while most completed passenger trips last no more than 15 minutes.

Driver-level waiting times are strongly polarized: some drivers have short average waits, while another group has substantially longer waits, producing a two-peaked distribution despite the long overall average.
summary: Taxi demand is concentrated from 08:00 to 16:00 and is lowest during the early morning. Passenger waiting time is substantially longer than passenger-trip duration, although most trips are short. Driver-level waiting times are polarized, with a short-wait group and a much longer-wait group rather than a uniform driver experience.
